findings.description: `.asc-item` padding dropped from 6 px to 4 px and `min-height` changed from `var(--min-tap)` to `auto`. This saves vertical space but risks compressed rows on small screens. Verify the layout doesn't look cramped on mobile or when accessibility font sizes are enlarged.

Uses `rgba(0,0,0,0.38)` as a fallback when `--disabled-text-color` is unavailable. This assumes a light background and will be hard to read in dark themes if HA's theme does not define the variable. Confirm `--disabled-text-color` is reliably present in the HA frontend context, or test in dark mode.

findings.issue: Unvisited edge case: undo button width
findings.description: Undo button now has 8 px vertical and 16 px horizontal padding (vs. 6 px / 14 px before). If an item name is very long and the button wraps to a second line due to flex reflow, the increased padding could compound layout issues. Verify layout on narrow screens with long item names.
